focus: Editorial standards, dual-review workflow, and paid-disclosure compliance
bio: Owns final quality before anything is filed: notability fit, neutrality, citation integrity, and Wikimedia disclosure language. Declines engagements that would require promotional framing or undeclared editing.

focus: Source discovery, reliability grading, and citation mapping
bio: Builds the source dossier before drafting begins — grading outlets for independence, depth, and editorial control. Maps every substantive claim to a usable reference and documents coverage gaps in plain language.

focus: Neutral drafting, structure, and living-person care
bio: Turns graded sources into encyclopedic prose with proportion and tone reviewers expect. Expands or repairs live articles without résumé padding, and keeps sensitive biography material inside policy.

focus: Watchlists, vandalism triage, and stabilisation after publication
bio: Watches published pages through their unstable early period, classifies incoming edits, escalates contested changes, and keeps clients informed without pretending anyone can lock an article.
